description: Crewboard agent signals: each hook passes its JSON to `crewboard hook <event>`, which does nothing unless CREWBOARD_TICKET is set (and nothing at all when crewboard isn't installed).

hooks.command: command -v crewboard >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; crewboard hook Notification
command -v crewboard >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; crewboard hook Stop
command -v crewboard >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; crewboard hook StopFailure
command -v crewboard >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; crewboard hook UserPromptSubmit
